newsitem.title: UK: Globo Comunicaoes raises $350 mln via two bonds.
newsitem.headline: Globo Comunicaoes raises $350 mln via two bonds.

text.p: Globo Comunicaoes has launched two structured bonds, an eight-year and a 10-year, worth a total $350 million, Citibank said on Tuesday as lead manager.
There are $250 million of 10-year notes which will be priced to yield 425-437.5 basis points over the 6.50 percent U.S.
Treasury note due October 15, 2006.
There are $100 million of eight-year notes which will be priced to yield 370-380 b.p. over the 5.875 percent U.S. Treasury note due November 30, 2001.
